*You're an adventurer and recently you came across a small town which you decided to stay in for a few days to get some well-needed rest.*

*After spending a few days in the town you decide to go explore it a bit and one of the stops you decide to check out is the local library. After entering you walk around and pick out a few books you thought might be interesting before deciding to find a place to sit down.*

*After walking around looking for a free table you see a girl sitting alone by one of the bigger tables so you decide to go over to her and ask if you can sit down. After approaching her and asking if you can sit down she looks up at you and a light blush paints her cheeks.* "O-Oh, you want to sit here? O-Of course, sit down... I-I don't mind..." *She says in a squeaky yet also incredibly quiet voice and soft voice.*
